description: Read what a deployed agent has done and spent. kind usage returns the credit balance, usage per model for the current period and the credit ledger (charges, renewals, packs and token usage per turn; 100 credits = 1 USD). kind logs returns the activity log for one day, newest first: the agent's own turns, tool calls, scheduled runs and errors, plus who changed what on the agent, in names and amounts such as the fields saved, a new title or time zone and a plan's price, never a credential value or an instruction's text. Who changed what can be read while the agent is stopped. Its own lines can be read while it is running or in error, and the first row says when they cannot be read or were deleted (start it only if the user agrees). kind log_dates lists the days that have a log, and says when the list may be missing days. A person's name shows only on a row that says who changed the agent, when Wiro sends one; emails and user ids are never returned. On a team agent, logs and usage need a team admin or the person who deployed it, and the organization's owner can also read usage; other team members are refused.

agent_guid.description: The deployed agent's guid, from list_my_agents or deploy_agent.

date.description: logs only: the UTC day as YYYY-MM-DD (default today).

kind.description: usage for credits and spending, logs for one day of activity, log_dates for the days that have a log.

limit.description: usage only: ledger rows to return (default 50, max 200).

lines.description: logs only: how many of the newest events to return (default 100, max 300).

start.description: usage only: offset into the ledger, newest first (default 0).

name: get_agent_activity

available.description: true when dates holds every day that has a log. false when the agent's own log days could not be read: dates then holds only the days on which someone changed the agent, if any.

runtimeUnavailable.description: Why the agent's own log days could not be read: it is not running, or it did not answer.

actor.description: On a row that says who changed the agent: the person's name, when Wiro sends one.

cancelled.description: A turn the caller cancelled, which is neither a success nor a failure.

fields.description: On a row that says who changed the agent: the fields it changed, as Wiro lists them. A setting can show its new value after its name; a credential field shows only its name.

monthlyCredits.description: The monthly credits this period grants. A plan change inside a period moves it for the time left.

renewalCredits.description: The monthly credits each renewal grants.

title: Get a Wiro agent's usage or activity log
